# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

Report privately through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/Chillboio-Studios/DawnChat-Flutter-Edition/security/advisories/new)
for this repository, or email the maintainers directly if advisories are unavailable.

Include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its impact
- Steps to reproduce or a proof of concept
- Affected versions / platforms

## What to expect

- We aim to acknowledge reports within 72 hours.
- We will coordinate a fix and disclosure timeline with you before any public announcement.
- Good-faith security research is welcome; please avoid accessing or modifying data that isn't yours.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release on the `bleeding` branch receives security fixes. Older releases may not be patched.
